purpose: Preserve the one allowed no-return entitlement, formula, and current-coverage acceptance outcome for the preregistered positive book-to-market mechanism.

interpretation.what_passed: The configured account can read the exact three-field daily_basic request, the reciprocal factor is finite and positive for retained rows, and current-session buyable-universe coverage exceeds the frozen acceptance threshold.
interpretation.what_did_not_pass: No 2019-2025 source-completeness, no-return uniqueness, capacity, return, stability, TopK, aggregation, current score, selection, sizing, or order gate has run.
interpretation.factor_return_conclusion: none; no factor return was read

next_allowed_step: Freeze a post-acceptance no-return full-history, uniqueness, and capacity protocol bound to this record before the fixed 2019-2025 sync.
stop_rules: Do not infer factor efficacy from entitlement or current-session coverage.
Do not request PE, market capitalization, turnover, price, dividend, limit-status, or another daily_basic field under this hypothesis.
Do not access factor returns before both the frozen no-return uniqueness and capacity gates pass.
Do not aggregate, score, select, size, or order from the acceptance frame.
